name: url-field
title: URL field
description: A web address field with a protocol menu: paste a full link and it splits, type a bare domain and it adds https, and it reports one clean URL.
docs: value is the whole address and onValueChange(url, { valid }) reports one clean URL: the protocol from the menu, the host in lower case and the rest as typed. A pasted link moves its protocol into the menu. protocols sets the menu (the first is used for a bare domain), requireHttps refuses http:// and offers a switch to https://, allowPath={false} takes a bare domain only, and name sends the URL in a hidden input. A valid address gets a link that opens a new tab with rel noopener noreferrer. The checks run when the field is left, then follow the typing until the address is right.
